People misunderstand acceptance. It doesn't mean giving up and surrendering power. Acceptance means not dwelling on stuff you can't change right now. It doesn't mean you'll never change it or that you're fine with it, it just means that you aren't going to waste your time feeling bad about it when that's not going to help anything. Applied to fats, acceptance means, "I'm fat right now and I'm not happy about that, but beating myself up about it doesn't make me thinner, so I'll spend my energy working out/building a diet/thinking about my lifestyle." It's an exercise in reducing suffering in the moment, not a pledge to ignore your failings forever.
